body:
Protasis accepts a study only when it states testable success criteria, and no check ever compares those criteria to what the run produced. A study declares what will be true at the end, the run reaches its terminal state on its own receipts, and the two are never joined.

## Status

`protasis-v5.10.0`, frontier revision `amendment-block-check`, status `mature`, Next Fiat job `None -- mature`. Read on `origin/main` at `5bc2494c` on 5 September 2026.

## Observed

`protasis-study-readiness` Boundary, in `plugins/hexaemeron/skills/protasis/SKILL.md`: "Readiness establishes the closed record, the reports checked at design lock and the declared stop points for later evidence. It does not establish that the selected design is correct, that pending conformance will pass, that implementation exists, or that later receipts are true."

`protasis-runbook-readiness` Boundary: "Runbook readiness establishes buildable specification content, the design lock, and the lexical shape of a declared version relation. It does not establish correct implementation, later conformance evidence, command success, relation suitability, a selected version or integration base, audit closure or delivery completion."

Both are accurate, and both face forward only. Protasis checks a study before the work and never after it. The promise it enforces, that success criteria are stated and testable, is spent entirely at the point the criteria are written.

A criterion is therefore satisfied by the run finishing rather than by anything settling it. A study can state a criterion no step tests, and both `done study` and the terminal path accept it.

## The shape

At the terminal phase, match each success criterion the accepted study declared to the evidence command that settled it, and report a criterion with no settling evidence as unmet rather than assumed. The criteria are already required to be testable, so make the join declared rather than inferred: have the study name, per criterion, the step and exit command expected to settle it, and check at the end that each named command ran and what it returned.

## Boundary

This establishes that each declared criterion has a named command and that the command ran with a recorded result. It does not establish that the command tests what the criterion means, that the criterion was the right one, or that the delivery is correct. A criterion mapped to a command that passes vacuously passes here too.

## Reopening

`protasis` is mature. This states the gap and a shape. Whether the frontier reopens, and what a held job would say, is the ledger's own decision under `VERSIONING.md`.

Fiat-Required: 1

The change edits `protasis.py`, `protasis/SKILL.md` and a terminal path in `hexctl.py`, so it owes the digest re-pins any controller edit owes, and reopening the ledger owes a generation row.

```carryover
none | none | this filing states one join and the meaning it does not check; the reopening decision stays with the ledger
```
title: protasis-wish: nothing checks a finished run against the success criteria its own study declared
